scope: Completed business HTTP requests; health, debug and scrapes excluded

source_presence.meaning: scrape_health_not_business_activity; stale rate values do not establish availability

missing_policy: No traffic gives undefined error ratio/latency, not normal zero. Missing, stale or failed source must be reported separately.
aggregation_policy: Rate each counter before summing replicas. Aggregate histogram buckets before quantile. Never average replica quantiles.
compatibility: Do not insert into the existing four-family profile or 62-column M13 model; collect separately until a versioned challenger is evaluated.
